paragraphs: Ammi Vardina'ah. Rashi, Beitzah 27a; Niddah 19b: beautiful as a rose; alternatively, a place name. Eruvin 49: Vardina’s people were stingy, narrow-eyed, and exacting with each other. Sotah 10a: in Abbahu’s name, in Yochanan’s name, etc. Nachman bar Yitzchak: “Because Ammi is beautiful, does he say unbeautiful teachings?”, Gittin 41a. He inspected the nasi’s firstborn animal, but not on a festival. Rabbi Ammi said he did well not to inspect, Beitzah there. In Yehudah Nesia’s time.
